title: 第十章 提前毕业第十一章 九尾来袭
slug: 火影之银色王座第九十四章恶魔
content_zh:
冥帝想要提前毕业了。
当冥帝和波风水门到达场地的时候场地上已经有三个人了、其中一个是冥帝的对手，以外另两个便是此次的准考官。
冥帝的对手是一个叫上流的家伙，此时的他已经是中忍。
考试之前，波风水门拍了拍冥帝的肩膀“我相信你！”
冥帝微微点了点头。
当时间刚刚到九点的时候一个老者出现恰恰出现在冥帝他们的视线中。
是他？团藏？冥帝心中一动。
“团藏大人。”尽管心里相当的不爽但是冥帝还是和大家一起给他行礼、毕竟他现在长老团的人、
根的创世人，在木叶地位很高。。
“第一次见面啊，冥帝。”团藏上下打量了冥帝一眼玩味的接着说：“不愧是可以暗部分队长鼬相提并论的人，你很不错。”
“额。”冥帝点了点头，很不想和团藏说话。
“好了时间差不多了可以开始了。”团藏不再罗嗦宣布开始。
“请多多指教”冥帝对着上流行了一礼。
上流一脸笑意，轻松地对冥帝点点头示意可以开始了。对付一个小鬼而已，上流觉得根本没什么大不了的。
冥帝手中拿着苦无静静的站在了那里。而上流拿着苦无狠狠的冲撞了上去！
中下忍的战斗就是这么直接、简单、粗暴。
两个人交错而过两只苦无擦出一阵火花。
紧接着，在擦身而过的霎那之间，冥帝脚下猛一用力，跃上半空中一个空翻对着上流再次掷出两只苦无。
“过程之中居然没有一点停顿，水门，你儿子真的很天才啊！”团藏声音深沉的对着水门道。水门微微一笑，并不说话。
随后冥帝右手再次掷出两只苦无。

上流一看冥帝掷出的苦无如此犀利，身体就本能的作出了判断开始了跳跃闪避。
就在他作出反应时后，冥帝嘴角一笑，又是投掷出两只苦无，两只苦无猛然加撞向前两只苦无然后四只苦无的轨迹瞬间生巨大变化，飞向上流的闪避处并封死了他的所有退路。
什么？上流一惊！
但是中忍到底是中忍，在最后关头仍强行在空中改变了自己的落点躲开了两只苦无。再用手中的苦无挡掉一只，最后仅有一支苦无堪堪滑过他的肩膀带起一抹血花。
冥帝知道这点伤势对上过战场的上流来说几乎没有任何影响。
但是冥帝的攻势，也没有这么快就结束了。
“哪有这么简单。”冥帝嘴角挂着淡淡的笑意，随即开始结印。‘蓬’的一声四只苦无爆炸了。
烟尘漫天，方才投掷出这些苦无是冥帝特制的，里面装上了‘引爆符’。
趁着烟雾，冥帝结了几个印，一个影分身瞬间出现在原地大吼了一声“风魔手里剑-影风车”
content_en:
Emperor Hades wants to graduate early.
When Emperor Hades and Minato Namikaze arrived at the venue, there were already three people on the field. One of them was the opponent of Emperor Hades, and the other two were the examiners.
The opponent of Emperor Hades is a guy named Shangli, who is already a chuunin at this time.
Before the exam, Minato Namikaze patted Hades on the shoulder, "I believe in you!"
Emperor Hades nodded slightly.
When the time just reached nine o'clock, an old man appeared right in the sight of Emperor Hades and the others.
Is it him? Danzo? Emperor Ming's heart moved.
"Danzo-sama." Even though he felt quite unhappy, Emperor Hades still saluted him along with everyone. After all, he is now a member of the Elder Council.
The founder of Gen has a very high status in Konoha. .
"This is our first meeting, Emperor Hades." Danzo looked at Emperor Hades up and down and said playfully: "As expected of someone who can be compared to the ANBU captain Itachi, you are very good."
"Uh." Underworld Emperor nodded, not wanting to talk to Danzo.
"Alright, it's almost time to start." Danzo announced the start without being wordy.
"Please give me some advice." Emperor Hades bowed to him.
The superior had a smile on his face and nodded to Emperor Hades easily to indicate that it was time to start. It was just a kid, and the upper class didn't think it was a big deal at all.
Emperor Hades stood there quietly with a kunai in his hand. And the upper class rushed forward with a kunai!
The battle of genin is so direct, simple and rough.
The two people passed each other and a burst of sparks flew between the two kunai.
Then, as they passed each other, Emperor Hades exerted force on his feet, leaped into the air, flipped, and threw two kunai at the upper stream again.
"There was no pause during the process, Minato, your son is really a genius!" Danzo said to Minato in a deep voice. Minato smiled slightly and said nothing.
Then Hades Emperor threw two kunai again with his right hand.
When the superior saw how sharp the kunai thrown by Hades was, his body instinctively made a judgment and started to jump to dodge.
Just as he was reacting, Hades smiled and threw two more kunai. The two kunai suddenly collided with the first two kunai. Then the trajectories of the four kunai changed dramatically in an instant, flying upstream to the dodge and blocking all his escape routes.
What? The upper class was shocked!
But a chuunin was a chuunin after all, and at the last moment he still forced himself to change his position in the air to avoid the two kunai. Then he blocked another one with the kunai in his hand. In the end, only one kunai slid over his shoulder and brought up a splash of blood.
Emperor Hades knew that this injury would have almost no impact on the upper class who had been on the battlefield.
But Hades Emperor's offensive did not end so quickly.
"It's not that simple." Emperor Ming had a faint smile on his lips and immediately began to form seals. Four kunai exploded with a "Peng" sound.
The sky was filled with smoke and dust. The kunai that had just been thrown were specially made by Emperor Hades and had 'detonating talismans' inside.
Taking advantage of the smoke, Hades formed a few seals, and a shadow clone instantly appeared on the spot and shouted "Wind Demon Shuriken - Shadow Windmill"
